# Phase 5 production release marker

This non-public marker requests a guarded production deployment after all repository gates pass.

Release scope:

- completed Phase 5 evidence-led network graph;
- verified-member Holehe email account-signal jobs;
- verified-member passive SpiderFoot footprint jobs;
- administrator-only h8mail exposure-review jobs;
- encrypted D1 targets, private polling runner and sanitised results;
- public Research Tools route and independent Email OSINT external link.

Production verification must confirm the exact merged SHA on both live hosts, healthy Worker and D1 services, gated tool endpoints, public tools routes and exclusion of private runner code and diagnostics.
